nodes.body:
# Remote mobile terminal rendering and lifecycle parity

Remote Web shall retain controller-side browser font rendering and shall never request desktop font RPCs. Its glyph rasterizer shall apply the same deterministic terminal-cell post-processing as the desktop path: Unicode Block Elements U+2580-U+259F render with cell-aligned opaque shared boundaries at every device pixel ratio, while Box Drawing connectors meet adjacent cells and ordinary glyphs, emoji, and shade blocks retain native browser antialiasing. TUI keyboard ownership must survive host context-menu interactions and suppress shell-history UI until an explicit prompt, alternate-screen exit, or reset releases the lease. Editor popups shall retain the active Monaco theme. On Windows, PTY teardown shall terminate the complete assigned Job Object process tree with the existing PID-tree fallback only when job assignment or termination fails. Acceptance requires pure raster bitmap tests, Remote browser/device-scale visual seam coverage, workspace/pane identity switching coverage, TUI context-menu regression coverage, editor theme mount coverage, a real parent-child-grandchild Job Object teardown test on Windows, PWA artifact verification that excludes desktop font RPCs, and the repository test, lint, typecheck, SpecTree verification, and completion gates. Publishing is permitted only after the existing artifact domains pass ordinary TLS validation; no insecure certificate bypass is allowed.

# TUI mobile terminal and PTY lifecycle hardening

Terminal UI keyboard ownership shall remain active through host context-menu interactions and shall not release based on an elapsed timer. A terminal that has emitted a durable inline-TUI signal suppresses Ridge shell-history UI until an explicit terminal prompt, alternate-screen exit, or reset signal releases the lease. Mouse-reporting terminals receive pointer input without browser context-menu leakage. Monaco editor theme selection shall use the active theme catalogue metadata and initialize only after the popup theme system is ready. On Windows, each PTY job uses kill-on-close semantics and explicit job termination so pane teardown reclaims its complete process tree, with the existing process-tree fallback retained when a job cannot be used. Remote/mobile artifacts must not request desktop-only terminal font RPCs; legacy requests fail immediately with a refresh-required error, and the PWA exposes an available update while applying it automatically only after backgrounding. Acceptance requires terminal gate and parser tests, remote input and PWA artifact checks, Monaco custom-theme coverage, PTY teardown coverage where platform support is available, and repository test, lint, typecheck, SpecTree verification, and completion gates.

nodes.body:
# Authenticated production latency attribution

## Contract

Diagnosis must measure the route actually invoked by the authenticated UI. Kernel remains the sole PTY/session authority. Reuse the existing opt-in Remote performance trace, performance measures, scheduler diagnostics and Rust tracing. Probes are disabled by default, bounded, metadata-only and removable. They may not change transport selection, batching, queue capacities, input retry policy, authentication, encryption, PTY byte order or dependent delta order. Behavioral experiments require a separate approved change after measurement.

Record source HEAD and dirty-state fingerprint separately from installed binary hash/version, frontend artifact hash, loaded resource URLs, active service-worker version, flags and observed transport. Source analysis alone cannot establish which build runs. Distinguish local Kernel HTTP and optional RTP1-over-WS from WAN WebRTC; distinguish signaling from payload, raw bytes from semantic deltas and declared interfaces from invoked UI paths.

## Measurements

Compare three layers on the same authenticated route: a small bounded application echo through existing business framing, queues and encryption without PTY; a controlled Kernel PTY child reply without rendering; and real UI input through parsing and render submission. Reuse an existing harmless request/response if it traverses the same route; any diagnostic echo surface requires explicit admission after authentication, size limits and no privilege expansion. Child replies use responses absent from the submitted input, so terminal-driver echo cannot satisfy the measurement. Also cover real available shells and TUIs. Exclude startup and authentication from steady-state samples.

Use client monotonic round trips and same-process monotonic spans only. Correlate existing RPC IDs, input source/sequence, pane activation and output sequence where present; never subtract unsynchronized host/client clocks. Instrument input capture, host receipt, PTY lock/write, output read, publish, enqueue/dequeue, send, client receipt, parse completion and render submission. Render submission is not physical presentation. Bound and explicitly report trace truncation and probe overhead.

Measure each encountered queue's bytes, depth, oldest-item age, enqueue/dequeue rates and overflow/resync counts. Attribute blocking lock waits, async scheduling and event-loop gaps, poll rearm/wakeup, feed/parser costs and render scheduling. Audit sequential RPC/ACK waits, connection reuse, batch timers, serialization/copies, encryption execution/order, duplicate subscriptions/raw-plus-delta delivery and cross-pane interference. Verify whether input or echo waits behind history, snapshots, resize ACKs, activation or reconnect. Verify actual worker execution and host WebView foreground/background/minimized behavior with traces.

For WebRTC resolve the selected candidate pair from transport.selectedCandidatePairId; record both candidate types, protocol/relay protocol, candidate-pair RTT statistics, channel ordering/reliability, bufferedAmount and application echo RTT. Candidate-pair STUN RTT is not application latency; relay use alone is not evidence of a bottleneck. Avoid saving credentials, candidate addresses or terminal payloads.

## Evidence and acceptance

For idle typing, sustained output plus typing, switching, history loading, reconnect and host foreground/background, record attempted/successful sample counts, P50/P95/P99/max, timeouts and raw distributions. Cover accessible localhost/LAN and the actual WAN/cellular route. Mark inaccessible scenarios NOT_COVERED with the precise missing resource. Network emulation is supplementary, isolated and explicitly labeled; no system networking changes or newly exposed ports. Recheck the historical 110–160 ms harness artifact and approximately five-second P95 without assuming HTTP or scheduler blame.

Unit tests validate opt-in behavior, bounded metadata retention, accurate selected-pair resolution, queue counters/age, overflow visibility and unchanged ordering/authentication. They do not prove production responsiveness. Run npm test, npm run lint and npm run typecheck; run relevant Rust checks when Rust probes change. Save one diagnosis report with topology and file:line anchors, reproducible commands, raw evidence paths, coverage gaps, ranked CONFIRMED/HYPOTHESIS findings, measured stall contributions, smallest evidence-justified next change and regression criteria. List executed tests, changed files and uncertainties. Never declare overall performance PASS from partial coverage.

## Isolated fixture admission

The existing benchmark runs only an owned test host and Kernel. A TLS directory override is admitted only with the existing test-fixture permission flag, requires an absolute path and fails closed for malformed configuration. Without that opt-in, the production TLS directory and certificate policy are unchanged. The fixture uses its own auth file and per-browser leaf SPKI pin, without changing system trust or the installed service certificate files. Cleanup uses the authenticated Kernel shutdown endpoint; retained temporary state must be disclosed.

nodes.body:
# Terminal visual coordinates and input fidelity

## Scope

Repair the five reported terminal/editor defects on the current branch. Preserve shell execution semantics, byte order, authentication, transport framing, persistence and unrelated work. Desktop, LAN and Cloud use the approved canonical terminal contract from ridge-signaling/src/terminal.rs. Incompatible peers fail explicitly; rendering consumes the bounded read-only viewport handoff without introducing another VT parser.

## Cursor

Anchor every painted cursor to its content row and cell, including across blink-off frames, viewport scrolling, output scrolling and partial scroll regions. During held-key navigation, every presentation frame reflects the current authoritative cursor cell immediately. Do not freeze the cursor until a guessed TUI quiet interval; only explicit VT synchronized-output transactions may defer presentation, with bounded recovery for an unclosed transaction. Preserve the last content coordinate rather than a stale viewport coordinate. Hide the cursor when its content leaves the viewport or is discarded. Structural reflow/screen changes invalidate obsolete anchors. Coalesced scrolls retain their actual movement count; the physical viewport transform still clamps to its height. Split native records at the existing u16 count limit instead of losing movement information.

## Links

ridge-term owns logical link detection, cell hit testing and link underline presentation for desktop and Remote; host adapters validate origin resources and execute opening. Scan complete logical lines before projecting targets to visual segments. Plain prose, MIME types and numeric ratios are not actionable file links. Preserve balanced URL/path punctuation. Only the validated target under the pointer receives link affordance on the existing modifier gesture; OSC8 metadata alone must not underline the whole terminal. Normal SGR text underline remains independent. Join only authoritative soft wraps, including bounded context beyond viewport edges (8192 cells per edge plus one boundary row). Keep hard breaks and real spaces separate. Wide-character wrap gaps carry an empty text override through the existing cell sidecar, contributing no logical character. Preserve grapheme text and map UTF-16 offsets directly to visible cells without a per-code-unit mapping allocation. Every visible segment opens the same complete validated target; preserve OSC8 precedence and existing URL/path validation.

## Editor styles

FileEditor and its integrated diff viewer keep readable syntax colors, chrome and cursor geometry during lazy mount and theme changes. Production CSP remains unchanged: when Monaco's internally generated head style.monaco-colors element is blocked, synchronize only that trusted theme through CSSOM constructable stylesheets. File contents and arbitrary style elements are never adopted. Remote FileViewer retains its external scoped styles, monospace read/edit surfaces, gutter and narrow viewport layout.

## TUI keyboard ownership

The native parser owns a durable TUI keyboard lease. Carry it through native delta and remote snapshots using the existing open-ended mode-state framing (internal code 65535). Mirror it before UI shortcut decisions. Cursor visibility or idle time does not release ownership; authoritative prompt/exit/reset signals do. ArrowUp/ArrowDown must never open shell history while the TUI owns input, including after idle and scrolling; restore shell history after a real return to shell.

## Multiline input

Unbracketed clipboard paste encodes each logical LF/CRLF/CR break as one CR Enter key, preserving source line order. Bracketed paste retains its body verbatim. Explicitly typed key sequences keep their existing encoding. Validate long multiline input against a real PowerShell 7.6.6 ConPTY, native parser, delta mirror and rendered order, using harmless numbered lines rather than replaying destructive user commands.

## Acceptance

Run npm test, npm run lint, npm run typecheck, terminal Rust tests, native parser regressions and the real PowerShell paste acceptance. Rebuild the consumed WASM/frontend assets. Run scripts/terminal-five-fixes-e2e.mjs against production output: verify actual Monaco colors under CSP, Remote FileViewer read/edit styles, GPU row order, and painted cursor/probe agreement through scrolling. Inspect final diff and deterministic stc verify/complete gates. Do not claim success from compilation, unit mocks or unchanged source alone.

nodes.body:
# Goal：M5.3 — Agent Communion Product Acceptance & Semantic Hardening

M5.2 已完成 Agent Communion 核心产品结构。

本轮禁止新增：
- scheduler framework
- model router
- cost optimizer
- Staff autoscaling
- workflow DSL
- 新 Task abstraction
- 新 ACP protocol

只修真实语义问题 + 做产品验收。

==================================================
1. 修正 WaitingApproval restore 语义
==================================================

运行中的正常语义：

AgentSession turn
→ ApprovalRequested
→ Task WaitingApproval
→ user approve
→ SAME turn continues

保持不变。

但应用/host 重启后：

ACP transport / provider subprocess 不持久化，
原 turn 无法继续。

因此 restore 时不得留下一个看似可直接 approve 的 zombie WaitingApproval。

明确恢复规则：

Running
→ Interrupted

WaitingApproval with lost live turn
→ Interrupted / equivalent recoverable state

Completed
→ Completed

Failed / Cancelled
→ 保持终态

Queued
→ 保持 Queued

Blocked
→ 根据 dependency 状态重新判断或保留可解释状态

UI 必须知道：
该 Task 需要 Resume，
而不是继续显示一个无效 Approve 按钮。

补测试：

WAITING_APPROVAL_LIVE_CONTINUES_SAME_TURN
WAITING_APPROVAL_AFTER_RESTART_REQUIRES_RESUME

必须证明：
- live approval 不产生第二个 prompt；
- restart 后不会向已经不存在的 turn 发送 approve。

==================================================
2. 消除所有 timing-flaky Worker tests
==================================================

禁止：

1ms timeout
sleep race
"Completed 或 Failed 都算 PASS"

改 fake ACP agent / test harness，
提供 deterministic control，例如：

pause_before_event
emit_event_on_signal
delay_policy via injected clock
manual terminal event

测试必须严格确定：

A.
task running
→ no terminal event
→ timeout 尚未触发
→ 仍 Running

B.
terminal event arrives first
→ Completed

C.
policy timeout arrives first
→ Failed(timeout)

D.
ApprovalRequested
→ WaitingApproval
→ approve
→ same turn
→ Completed

所有 worker tests 必须稳定重复运行。

至少循环执行相关测试 50 次，
0 flaky 才算通过。

==================================================
3. Interrupted completion semantics
==================================================

审查所有：

is_terminal()
is_execution_stopped()
is_success_terminal()
is_recoverable()

caller。

禁止 workflow 使用模糊的：

all(task.is_terminal())

来判断成功完成。

明确 workflow outcome：

Completed
= success

Failed / Cancelled
= unsuccessful terminal

Blocked
= unresolved because upstream failed/config

Interrupted
= stopped + recoverable

WaitingApproval
= active but paused

WorkflowCoordinator 必须区分：

workflow_success
workflow_finished_with_failure
workflow_recoverable
workflow_active

补测试：

INTERRUPTED_NOT_SUCCESS
INTERRUPTED_VISIBLE_IN_LEAD_OUTCOME
WAITING_APPROVAL_NOT_FINISHED
BLOCKED_NOT_SUCCESS

==================================================
4. Plan Review 真正产品化验收
==================================================

验证真实产品流程，而不只是 reducer/types：

complex request
→ Lead proposes Plan
→ UI inline 展示 Story/Task
→ 用户可以在执行前修改：

title
point
dependency
assignee

→ Confirm
→ canonical PlanStore 更新
→ run_plan

UI 不维护 Plan 副本。

Cancel review
→ 不运行 Staff。

Simple Chat 不得进入该路径。

必须证明：

SIMPLE_CHAT_NO_PLAN
COMMUNION_REQUIRES_CONFIRM_BEFORE_RUN

除非产品已经有明确 Auto Run 开关，
否则禁止 Lead 生成 Plan 后立即执行。

==================================================
5. Communion Sidebar 产品验收
==================================================

检查实际 UI，而不是只检查 reducer。

保持：

Header
- Agent / Communion mode
- Provider
- Model
- Effort
- New Chat

Body
- single continuous chat

Composer
- input
- Send
- Cancel

Communion inline 展示：

Lead
Plan
Task
Staff
Tool
Approval
Artifact/Diff
Handoff
LeadFinal

不要引入：
- Staff Tabs
- Jira board
- workflow designer
- 独立 Task management page

==================================================
6. Structured LeadFinal 产品路径
==================================================

产品主路径必须使用：

LeadFinalOutcome {
  task_outcomes[]
  failed_or_blocked[]
  summary
}

不要让 UI 主路径最终退化成只消费：

CommutationCompleted { summary: String }

string event 可以保留 compatibility。

UI 至少可以展示：

Task
Staff
status
summary
artifacts
diff/check

默认紧凑，
需要时展开详情。

==================================================
7. Resume UX
==================================================

真实恢复场景：

A Completed
B Completed
C Running
D Queued

restart

→ A Completed
→ B Completed
→ C Interrupted
→ D 仍不允许越过 dependency
→ UI 显示 Resume C

用户 Resume C：

same Task ID
new execution attempt
fresh AgentSession
fresh transport

A/B 不得重新执行。

建议明确 execution attempt identity，
如果当前已经有等价机制则复用，
不要再造复杂 runtime。

==================================================
8. Headed Tauri acceptance
==================================================

如果当前环境能够运行 GUI：

必须实际启动 Ridge Desktop。

Scenario A — Simple Chat

open Agent Communion
→ single Agent
→ prompt
→ streaming
→ tool
→ approval
→ final

Scenario B — Communion

complex task
→ Lead Plan
→ review
→ confirm
→ A
→ B/C parallel Staff
→ approval on one Staff
→ same-turn continue
→ Handoff
→ D
→ structured LeadFinal

Scenario C — Restore

workflow running
→ restart
→ Interrupted shown
→ Resume
→ workflow continues
→ no completed Task repeated

如果环境没有 headed WebView：
明确 HEADED_UI=NOT_RUN。
不要用 reducer/unit tests 写成 UI PASS。

==================================================
9. Provider live E2E

如果存在 OpenAI/Anthropic 凭据：
顺带跑真实 ACP provider acceptance。

如果不存在：
继续 NOT_RUN。

不要为了验收引入 direct OpenAI / Anthropic SDK。

==================================================
10. Ridge Core boundary

重新确认本轮没有：

Kernel → Plan
PTY → Staff
Remote → Workflow
RTP1 → Communion

Agent Communion 继续完全位于产品层。

==================================================
最终输出

WAITING_APPROVAL_RUNTIME
WAITING_APPROVAL_RESTORE

WORKER_DETERMINISM
FLAKY_TESTS

INTERRUPTED_SEMANTICS
WORKFLOW_COMPLETION_SEMANTICS

SIMPLE_CHAT
PLAN_REVIEW
COMMUNION_EXECUTION

STRUCTURED_LEAD_FINAL
RESUME_FLOW

HEADED_TAURI_ACCEPTANCE
LIVE_PROVIDER_ACCEPTANCE

RIDGE_CORE_BOUNDARY

REMAINING_GAPS
COMMUNION_PRODUCT_READY

`COMMUNION_PRODUCT_READY=YES`
只能在没有已知产品语义 bug，
且测试不再存在 timing flake 时给出。

若 headed GUI/provider credential 缺失，
可单独 NOT_RUN，
不得伪造。

普通实现问题自行修复继续。

未经授权不 push/tag/release/deploy。
